descriptionEn: The funniest British old man I've ever met. My instructor, my inspiration behind the bar.
descriptionZh: 我见过的最幽默的英国小老头。我在吧台后的老师。

details.notesEn:
Bryan Evans is the funniest British old man I have ever met behind a bar. He has the kind of beard that belongs in a folk song and the kind of laugh that fills a room before the joke is even finished.

I earned my New York bartending certification under his instruction. The certificate is somewhere in a drawer. The things he taught me are not.
details.notesZh:
Bryan Evans 是我在吧台后见过的最幽默的英国小老头。他留着一把属于民谣歌曲的胡子，笑声在笑话还没说完之前就已经把整个房间填满了。

我在他的指导下取得了纽约调酒师证书。证书放在抽屉的某个角落。他教给我的东西，不在那里。

descriptionEn: Blackstrap rum, Campari, pineapple, lime, simple syrup. Bitter tropical paradise.
descriptionZh: 黑糖朗姆、金巴利、菠萝、青柠、糖浆。苦涩的热带天堂。

details.eyebrowZh: 提基 · 摇制 · 酒精度约16%
stepsEn: Combine all ingredients in a shaker with ice.
Shake hard for 12 seconds.
Strain over crushed ice in a rocks glass or tiki mug.
Garnish with a pineapple frond and a cherry. If you have them, add a paper umbrella without apology.
The drink should be a deep ruby-orange color from the Campari and pineapple.
stepsZh: 将所有材料加入装有冰块的摇壶。
用力摇12秒。
过滤至装有碎冰的岩石杯或提基杯。
用菠萝叶和樱桃装饰。如果有小纸伞，坦然插上。
这杯酒应呈现深宝石橙红色，来自金巴利和菠萝汁的融合。
details.notesEn: Created in 1978 at the Kuala Lumpur Hilton. The Jungle Bird was largely forgotten until it was rediscovered around 2010 by cocktail writers. It is the only classic tiki drink that uses Campari, which creates a fascinating tension between tropical sweetness and Italian bitterness. The blackstrap rum is essential — its molasses depth cuts through everything.
details.notesZh: 1978年创制于吉隆坡希尔顿酒店。丛林鸟在很大程度上被遗忘，直到2010年前后被鸡尾酒作家重新发现。它是唯一使用金巴利的经典提基饮品，在热带甜美与意式苦涩之间制造了迷人的张力。黑糖朗姆酒不可替代——它的糖蜜深度能穿透一切。

metaZh: 新奥尔良经典 · 摇制
descriptionEn: Gin, citrus, cream, egg white, orange blossom water. The 12-minute shake cocktail.
descriptionZh: 金酒、柑橘、奶油、蛋白、橙花水。需要摇12分钟的鸡尾酒。

details.eyebrowZh: 新奥尔良经典 · 摇制 · 酒精度约14%

metaEn.label: Ice
metaEn.value: Shake with ice, serve no ice

stepsEn: Combine all ingredients except soda in a shaker without ice. Dry shake for at least 2 minutes — traditionally 12. The longer, the better the foam.
Add ice and shake another 5 minutes if you can manage it. Your arms will ache. This is the point.
Strain into a chilled Collins glass with no ice.
Slowly pour soda water down the side of the glass. The foam will rise dramatically above the rim.
Serve immediately. Do not garnish. The foam pillow above the glass rim is the presentation.
stepsZh: 将所有材料（除苏打水）放入摇壶，不加冰，干摇至少2分钟——传统要求12分钟。摇得越久，泡沫越好。
如果能坚持，加入冰块再摇5分钟。手臂会酸痛，这是意义所在。
滤入无冰的冷藏柯林斯杯中。
将苏打水缓缓沿杯壁倒入，泡沫会壮观地升出杯口。
立即上桌，无需装饰。高出杯口的泡沫枕头就是最好的呈现。
details.notesEn: Henry Ramos invented this in 1888 in New Orleans. During Mardi Gras, he employed 35 shaker boys working in relay to keep up with demand. The absurd shaking time is not theatre — it is chemistry. The cream and egg white need mechanical force to emulsify into that impossibly light foam.
details.notesZh: 亨利·拉莫斯于1888年在新奥尔良发明了这款鸡尾酒。狂欢节期间，他雇了35名摇酒男孩轮流接力才能满足需求。荒谬的摇制时长不是表演——而是化学反应。奶油和蛋白需要机械力才能乳化成那层难以置信的轻盈泡沫。

descriptionEn: Equal parts bourbon, Aperol, Amaro Nonino, lemon. Perfect symmetry in a glass.
descriptionZh: 波本、艾普罗、诺尼诺阿马罗、柠檬各等份。杯中的完美对称。

details.eyebrowZh: 现代经典 · 摇制 · 酒精度约22%
stepsEn: Combine all four ingredients in equal measure in a cocktail shaker with ice. There is no flexibility in the ratio — that is the point of the drink.
Shake hard for 12 seconds.
Double-strain into a chilled coupe.
No garnish. The simplicity of presentation mirrors the purity of the recipe.
stepsZh: 将四种材料等量倒入装有冰块的摇壶。比例没有任何弹性——这正是这款酒的精髓所在。
用力摇12秒。
双重过滤至冰镇碟形杯。
无需装饰。呈现的简洁映照着配方的纯粹。
details.notesEn: Created by Sam Ross (who also invented the Penicillin) in 2007, named after the M.I.A. song. The equal-parts format is elegantly democratic — no single ingredient dominates. The Amaro Nonino is non-negotiable; other amaros change the drink entirely. It is the rare modern cocktail that deserves to be called a classic.
details.notesZh: 由萨姆·罗斯（同时也是青霉素鸡尾酒的发明者）于2007年创作，以M.I.A.的同名歌曲命名。等份配方优雅而民主——没有任何一种材料主导全局。诺尼诺阿马罗是不可替代的；换成其他阿马罗会彻底改变这款酒。它是极少数值得被称为经典的现代鸡尾酒。

metaZh: 经典 · 直调 · 热饮
descriptionEn: Whisky, honey, lemon, hot water. The only cocktail that works as medicine.
descriptionZh: 威士忌、蜂蜜、柠檬、热水。唯一能当药喝的鸡尾酒。

details.eyebrowZh: 经典 · 直调 · 热饮 · 酒精度约14%

metaEn.label: Ice
metaEn.value: None — it is a hot drink

ingrEn: 1.5 oz (45ml) Whisky (Scotch, Irish, or Bourbon — all work)
4–5 oz Hot water (just off the boil)
ingrZh: 1.5 oz (45ml) 威士忌（苏格兰、爱尔兰或波本均可）
4-5 oz 热水（刚煮沸后稍凉）
stepsEn: Warm your mug first by filling it with hot water for a minute, then discard the water.
Add honey to the warm mug and pour a small amount of hot water over it to dissolve.
Add whisky and lemon juice.
Top with hot water. Stir gently.
Add cinnamon stick and cloves. Garnish with a lemon wheel studded with cloves.
Let it steep for 1 minute before drinking — the cinnamon opens up.
stepsZh: 先用热水温杯一分钟，倒掉热水。
将蜂蜜放入温热的杯中，倒入少量热水溶解。
加入威士忌和柠檬汁。
注入热水，轻轻搅拌。
放入肉桂棒和丁香，用插了丁香的柠檬片装饰。
饮用前静置1分钟——肉桂香气会充分散发。
details.notesEn: Genuinely medicinal — the warmth opens blood vessels, honey soothes, lemon has vitamin C, and whisky makes you not care about the cold. My go-to for winter evenings or the first sign of illness. Irish whiskey is traditional; I prefer a smoky Scotch for more depth.
details.notesZh: 货真价实的药用效果——温热扩张血管，蜂蜜润喉，柠檬含维C，而威士忌让你不再在乎寒冷。我在冬夜或初显病兆时的首选。爱尔兰威士忌是传统选择；我更偏好烟熏苏格兰威士忌，层次更深。

descriptionEn: 1 oz gin · 1 oz Campari · 1 oz sweet vermouth. Orange twist. Perfect every time.
descriptionZh: 金酒1oz · 金巴利1oz · 甜苦艾酒1oz。橙皮装饰。次次完美。

details.eyebrowZh: 经典 · 搅拌 · 酒精度约24%
ingrZh: 1 oz (30ml) 甜苦艾酒（推荐Carpano Antica）
stepsEn: Add all ingredients to a mixing glass filled with large ice.
Stir for 30 seconds until well-chilled and properly diluted.
Strain into a rocks glass over a single large ice cube.
Express an orange twist over the surface — hold the peel an inch above the glass and snap it.
Rub the peel around the rim and drop it in, or balance it on the rim.
stepsZh: 将所有材料倒入装有大冰块的调酒杯。
搅拌30秒，使其充分冷却并适度稀释。
用隔冰匙滤入放有大冰块的岩石杯。
将橙皮扭转表达油脂——离杯面约3厘米处用力折压橙皮。
橙皮擦杯口后放入杯中，或搭在杯沿。
details.notesEn: The equal-parts ratio is sacrosanct. Don't shake — stirring gives the Negroni its silky, clarified texture. I prefer Carpano Antica for vermouth; it adds a vanilla richness.
details.notesZh: 三等份的比例是神圣的。不要摇——搅拌赋予内格罗尼丝滑清澈的质感。我偏好Carpano Antica苦艾酒，它带来香草般的丰润感。

descriptionEn: Baileys, coconut rum, coconut cream, milk. Rich, creamy, dangerously drinkable.
descriptionZh: 百利甜、椰子朗姆、椰浆、牛奶。浓郁丝滑，危险地好喝。

details.eyebrowZh: 原创 · 摇制 · 酒精度约11%

metaEn.label: Ice
metaEn.value: Shake with ice, serve over ice or up

metaZh.label: 冰块
metaZh.value: 加冰摇制，加冰或滤冰上桌

ingrEn: 1 oz (30ml) Whole milk or oat milk
ingrZh: 1 oz (30ml) 椰子朗姆酒（马利宝或同类）
1 oz (30ml) 全脂牛奶或燕麦奶
stepsEn: Combine all ingredients in a shaker with plenty of ice.
Shake hard for 12 seconds — the coconut cream needs good agitation to integrate fully.
Strain over fresh ice in a rocks glass, or double-strain into a chilled coupe.
Toast a small handful of coconut flakes in a dry pan until golden. Sprinkle over the top.
The salt is subtle but essential — it cuts through the sweetness and rounds out the coconut.
stepsZh: 将所有材料加入装有大量冰块的摇壶。
用力摇12秒——椰浆需要充分摇晃才能完全融合。
过滤至放有新冰块的岩石杯，或双重过滤至冰镇碟形杯。
干锅小火将椰丝烤至金黄，撒在表面。
盐的用量极少但不可缺——它能化解甜腻，让椰子风味更圆润。
details.notesEn: This one was born out of a late-night experiment — I had Baileys, I had coconut rum, and I had no intention of drinking either straight. The sea salt is the move that makes it. Without it, it tastes like dessert; with it, it tastes like a cocktail. The toasted coconut garnish adds a nutty, slightly smoky contrast that I find impossible to skip.
details.notesZh: 这款酒诞生于一个深夜的实验——手边有百利甜，有椰子朗姆，但两样都不想直接喝。海盐是点睛之笔。没有它，喝起来像甜品；加了它，才像一杯鸡尾酒。烤椰丝的装饰带来坚果香和轻微烟熏感的对比，让我每次都无法省略。

descriptionEn: White rum, coconut cream, pineapple juice. Puerto Rico's national drink. Sunshine in a glass.
descriptionZh: 白朗姆、椰浆、菠萝汁。波多黎各的国民饮品。一杯阳光。

details.eyebrowZh: 经典 · 搅拌/摇制 · 酒精度约13%
stepsEn: Combine rum, coconut cream, pineapple juice, and ice in a blender.
Blend until completely smooth — about 30 seconds. No chunks.
Pour into a chilled hurricane glass or coupe.
Garnish with a pineapple wedge and a cherry. A paper umbrella is not optional — it is mandatory.
Alternatively: shake all ingredients hard with ice for 15 seconds and double-strain for a lighter, less frozen version.
stepsZh: 将朗姆酒、椰浆、菠萝汁和冰块放入搅拌机。
搅拌至完全顺滑，约30秒，不能有冰块颗粒。
倒入冰镇飓风杯或碟形杯。
用菠萝角和樱桃装饰。小纸伞不是可选的——是必须的。
备选：所有材料加冰大力摇15秒，双重过滤，口感更轻盈不那么冰冻。
details.notesEn: Invented in 1954 at the Caribe Hilton in San Juan, Puerto Rico, by bartender Ramón "Monchito" Marrero. It took him three months to perfect the recipe. Puerto Rico declared it the national drink in 1978. The blended version is the classic; the shaken version is what you make when you don't own a blender and have no regrets about it.
details.notesZh: 1954年由调酒师拉蒙·"蒙奇托"·马雷罗在波多黎各圣胡安的加勒比希尔顿发明，历时三个月打磨配方。1978年被波多黎各定为国饮。搅拌机版本是经典做法；摇制版本是当你没有搅拌机时的选择，同样毫无遗憾。

descriptionEn: 2 oz bourbon · demerara sugar · Angostura · orange bitters. Express orange peel.
descriptionZh: 波本2oz · 德梅拉拉糖 · 安格斯图拉苦精 · 橙皮苦精。

details.eyebrowZh: 经典 · 搅拌 · 酒精度约35%
ingrEn: 1 tsp Demerara sugar syrup (or 1 sugar cube)
ingrZh: 2 oz (60ml) 波本或黑麦威士忌
1茶匙 德梅拉拉糖浆（或1块方糖）
stepsEn: In a rocks glass, add the sugar syrup and both bitters. Stir briefly.
Add a large ice cube.
Pour whiskey over the ice.
Stir gently 15–20 seconds to chill and dilute slightly.
Express an orange peel over the glass, rub around the rim, and drop in. Add a cherry if desired.
stepsZh: 在岩石杯中加入糖浆和两种苦精，简单搅匀。
放入大冰块。
将威士忌倒在冰块上。
轻轻搅拌15-20秒，使其冷却并适度稀释。
在杯口上方扭转橙皮取油，擦杯口，放入杯中。喜欢的话可以加颗樱桃。
details.notesEn: The Old Fashioned is a spirit-forward drink. Don't muddle the orange and cherry — that's a common mistake. Let the spirit shine.
details.notesZh: 古典鸡尾酒是以酒为主角的饮品。不要研磨橙片和樱桃——那是常见错误。让威士忌本身发光。

descriptionEn: Tequila, triple sec, fresh lime. Salt rim essential. The world's most ordered cocktail.
descriptionZh: 龙舌兰、橙皮力娇酒、新鲜青柠。盐边必不可少。全球点单最多的鸡尾酒。

details.eyebrowZh: 经典 · 摇制 · 酒精度约20%
ingrEn: Salt for the rim (optional but traditional)
ingrZh: ½ oz (15ml) 橙皮力娇酒或君度
盐（用于杯口，可选但是传统做法）
stepsEn: Prepare the salt rim: run a lime wedge around half the rim (not the full rim, so guests can choose), then dip in coarse salt.
Combine tequila, lime juice, triple sec and agave syrup in a shaker with ice.
Shake hard for 12 seconds.
Strain over fresh ice in the rocks glass, or up into a coupe.
Garnish with a lime wheel on the rim.
stepsZh: 准备盐边：用青柠角沿半边杯口擦一圈（不要整圈，让客人自行选择），然后蘸上粗盐。
将龙舌兰、青柠汁、橙皮力娇酒和龙舌兰糖浆放入加了冰的摇壶。
用力摇12秒。
滤入放了新冰块的岩石杯，或滤入碟形杯。
用青柠片搭在杯口装饰。
details.notesEn: Use 100% agave tequila — the mixto stuff (less than 100% agave) makes headaches, not margaritas. Fresh lime juice only. I use agave syrup instead of simple syrup to keep the agave thread running through the drink. Half-salted rim is the civilized approach.
details.notesZh: 使用100%龙舌兰蒸馏酒——混合酒（低于100%龙舌兰）只会带来头痛，不是玛格丽特。只用新鲜青柠汁。我用龙舌兰糖浆代替简单糖浆，让龙舌兰的风格贯穿整杯酒。半边盐口才是文明人的选择。

descriptionEn: Whisky sour topped with a red wine float. The visual alone is worth it.
descriptionZh: 威士忌酸酒上漂浮一层红葡萄酒。光是视觉就值回票价。

details.eyebrowZh: 现代经典 · 摇制 · 酒精度约18%
ingrEn: ½ oz (15ml) Full-bodied red wine (Malbec or Shiraz)
ingrZh: 2 oz (60ml) 黑麦或波本威士忌
½ oz (15ml) 浓郁红葡萄酒（马尔贝克或西拉）
stepsEn: Dry shake whiskey, lemon, syrup and egg white without ice for 15 seconds.
Add ice and shake hard for 12 seconds.
Double-strain into a rocks glass over a large ice cube.
Float the red wine: pour it slowly over the back of a bar spoon held just above the surface of the drink. It should sit in a distinct layer on top.
Garnish with a lemon wheel. The visual contrast is the whole point.
stepsZh: 将威士忌、柠檬汁、糖浆和蛋白干摇15秒，不加冰。
加入冰块大力摇12秒。
双重过滤至放有大冰块的岩石杯中。
漂浮红酒：将吧勺背面贴近酒液表面，缓缓将红酒沿勺背倒入，使其形成清晰的分层。
用柠檬片装饰。视觉对比才是这杯酒的灵魂。
details.notesEn: The New York Sour is a Whisky Sour with a red wine float — simple in concept, stunning in execution. Use a full-bodied red with some fruit character (Malbec works beautifully). The float must be poured slowly or it sinks and muddies everything.
details.notesZh: 纽约酸酒是加了红酒漂浮层的威士忌酸酒——概念简单，呈现惊艳。使用浓郁果香的红酒（马尔贝克效果极佳）。漂浮层必须缓慢倒入，否则会沉下去，混浊一片。

descriptionEn: Vodka, fresh espresso, coffee liqueur. Three coffee beans on top. The crowd-pleaser.
descriptionZh: 伏特加、新鲜浓缩咖啡、咖啡利口酒。顶部三颗咖啡豆。人见人爱。

details.eyebrowZh: 现代经典 · 摇制 · 酒精度约20%
ingrEn: 1 oz (30ml) Fresh espresso (hot or room temp)
½ oz (15ml) Coffee liqueur (Kahlúa or Mr. Black)
ingrZh: 1 oz (30ml) 新鲜意式浓缩咖啡（热或室温）
½ oz (15ml) 咖啡利口酒（卡鲁哇或Mr. Black）
¼ oz (7ml) 简单糖浆（按口味调整）
stepsEn: Pull a fresh espresso shot and let it cool slightly — do not refrigerate, as this kills the crema.
Combine vodka, espresso, coffee liqueur, and syrup in a shaker with plenty of ice.
Shake very hard for 15 seconds. The vigorous shaking is what creates the foam.
Double-strain into a chilled coupe to catch all the ice chips.
The foam should be thick and mahogany-colored. Place 3 coffee beans on top — tradition says they represent health, wealth, and happiness.
stepsZh: 拉一杯新鲜的意式浓缩，稍微放凉——不要冷藏，那会破坏咖啡脂。
将伏特加、浓缩咖啡、咖啡利口酒和糖浆加入装有大量冰块的摇壶。
用力摇15秒，大力摇制才能产生泡沫。
双重过滤入冰镇碟形杯，滤掉所有细小冰渣。
泡沫应该厚实且呈深棕色。顶部放3颗咖啡豆——传统寓意健康、财富和幸福。
details.notesEn: Invented by Dick Bradsell in London in the 1980s, allegedly for a model who asked for something to wake her up. The key is fresh espresso — pre-made cold brew or instant will not produce the same foam. I prefer Mr. Black over Kahlúa for its drier, more intense coffee character.
details.notesZh: 由迪克·布拉德塞尔于1980年代在伦敦发明，据说是应一位模特要求调制的提神饮料。关键在于新鲜浓缩咖啡——预制冷萃或速溶咖啡无法产生同样的泡沫。比起卡鲁哇，我更偏好Mr. Black，因为它的咖啡风味更干、更浓郁。

descriptionEn: White rum, fresh lime, mint, sugar, soda. Cuba's most exported cocktail.
descriptionZh: 白朗姆、新鲜青柠、薄荷、糖、苏打水。古巴出口最广的鸡尾酒。

details.eyebrowZh: 经典 · 直调 · 酒精度约12%
ingrZh: 2 oz (60ml) 白朗姆酒（推荐哈瓦那俱乐部3年）
¾ oz (22ml) 简单糖浆（或2茶匙糖）
stepsEn: Add mint leaves and simple syrup to the glass. Gently clap the mint between your palms first to release the oils — do not muddle hard or it turns bitter.
Add lime juice and rum.
Fill the glass with crushed ice.
Top with soda water. Stir gently once from the bottom.
Garnish with a generous mint sprig. Slap it against your palm before placing — the aroma is part of the drink.
stepsZh: 将薄荷叶和糖浆放入杯中。先把薄荷叶放在掌心轻拍以释放精油——不要用力研磨，否则会变苦。
加入青柠汁和朗姆酒。
装满碎冰。
加入苏打水，从底部轻轻搅拌一次。
用一大枝薄荷装饰。放入前先用手掌拍打——香气是这杯酒体验的一部分。
details.notesEn: The mojito is deceptively simple and deceptively easy to ruin. The two most common mistakes: muddling the mint too aggressively (releases chlorophyll, tastes grassy and bitter) and using too little lime. The mint should be fragrant, not macerated. Use crushed ice if you have it — it dilutes at the right rate and keeps the drink cold longer.
details.notesZh: 莫吉托看似简单，却很容易毁掉。最常见的两个错误：过度研磨薄荷（释放叶绿素，味道发苦发草）以及青柠汁放太少。薄荷应该香气四溢，而不是被碾碎。有碎冰用碎冰——稀释速度恰到好处，保冷时间也更长。

descriptionEn: 2 oz white rum · ¾ oz lime · ¾ oz simple syrup. The holy trinity.
descriptionZh: 白朗姆2oz · 青柠汁¾oz · 糖浆¾oz。三位一体。

details.eyebrowZh: 经典 · 摇制 · 酒精度约20%
ingrZh: 2 oz (60ml) 白朗姆酒（推荐哈瓦那俱乐部3年）
stepsEn: Chill your coupe glass in the freezer, or with ice water.
Combine all ingredients in a cocktail shaker with plenty of ice.
Shake hard for 12–15 seconds — you want the shaker to be frost-covered.
Double-strain through a Hawthorne strainer and fine mesh into the chilled coupe.
No garnish needed. The drink speaks for itself.
stepsZh: 将碟形杯放入冰箱预冷，或用冰水冰杯。
所有材料加入波士顿摇酒壶，放入大量冰块。
用力摇制12-15秒，至摇酒壶外壁结霜。
用霍桑隔冰器和细网过滤器双重过滤至冰镇的碟形杯中。
无需装饰，酒本身就是答案。
details.notesEn: A Daiquiri is a technical benchmark — if you can make a great Daiquiri, you understand balance. Fresh lime juice only; bottled juice is not acceptable.
details.notesZh: 得其利是调酒技术的标杆——会做好一杯得其利，就懂得了平衡。只用新鲜青柠汁，瓶装果汁不可接受。

descriptionEn: Bourbon, lemon juice, simple syrup, egg white. Silky, frothy, perfectly balanced.
descriptionZh: 波本、柠檬汁、糖浆、蛋白。丝滑、起沫、完美平衡。

details.eyebrowZh: 经典 · 摇制 · 酒精度约18%
ingrZh: 2滴 安格斯图拉苦精（用于泡沫）
stepsEn: Dry shake: combine whiskey, lemon juice, syrup and egg white in a shaker without ice. Shake hard for 15 seconds.
Add ice and wet shake for another 12–15 seconds until well chilled.
Double-strain into a rocks glass over ice, or into a chilled coupe.
Drop 2 dashes of Angostura on the foam and drag a toothpick through to create a pattern.
Garnish with an orange half-wheel and a cherry.
stepsZh: 干摇：将威士忌、柠檬汁、糖浆和蛋白放入摇壶，不加冰用力摇15秒。
加入冰块继续摇12-15秒，至充分冷却。
双重过滤倒入放有冰块的岩石杯，或冰镇碟形杯中。
在泡沫上滴2滴安格斯图拉苦精，用牙签划出图案。
用橙片和樱桃装饰。
details.notesEn: The egg white is what separates a whisky sour from a good whisky sour. It adds texture, body, and a canvas for the bitters art. Don't skip it. I use a 2:¾:½ ratio, which I find more balanced than the traditional equal-parts approach.
details.notesZh: 蛋白是威士忌酸酒和好的威士忌酸酒之间的区别。它增添了质感、厚度，也是苦精图案的画布。不要省略。我用2:¾:½的比例，比传统等份更为平衡。

descriptionEn: Pisco, fresh lime, simple syrup, egg white, Angostura. Peru's national cocktail.
descriptionZh: 皮斯科、青柠、糖浆、蛋白、安格斯图拉苦精。秘鲁国民鸡尾酒。

details.eyebrowZh: 经典 · 摇制 · 酒精度约16%

metaZh.label: 装饰
metaZh.value: 泡沫上滴3滴安格斯图拉苦精

ingrZh: 3滴 安格斯图拉苦精（用于泡沫）
stepsEn: Dry shake: combine pisco, lime juice, syrup and egg white in a shaker without ice. Shake hard for 15 seconds to emulsify the egg white.
Add ice and wet shake for another 12 seconds until well chilled.
Double-strain into a chilled coupe.
Drop exactly 3 drops of Angostura bitters onto the foam. Do not stir — the pattern is part of the presentation.
Serve immediately.
stepsZh: 干摇：将皮斯科、青柠汁、糖浆和蛋白放入摇壶，不加冰用力摇15秒使蛋白乳化。
加入冰块继续摇12秒，至充分冷却。
双重过滤至冰镇碟形杯。
在泡沫上精确滴3滴安格斯图拉苦精，不要搅动——图案是呈现的一部分。
立即上桌。
details.notesEn: The Pisco Sour is to Peru what the Negroni is to Italy — a point of national pride and endless debate. Peruvians will insist on Quebranta pisco and lime (not lemon); Chileans make their version with lemon and without egg white. I side with Peru. The three drops of Angostura on the foam are non-negotiable — they add a faint spice that ties everything together and make the drink instantly recognizable.
details.notesZh: 皮斯科酸酒之于秘鲁，正如内格罗尼之于意大利——是民族自豪感与无休止争论的交汇点。秘鲁人坚持用Quebranta皮斯科和青柠；智利人则用柠檬且不加蛋白。我站秘鲁这边。泡沫上的三滴安格斯图拉是不可妥协的——它们带来一丝若有若无的香料气息，将整杯酒串联在一起，也让这杯酒一眼可辨。

descriptionEn: Gin and dry vermouth, stirred cold and served colder. A civilized drink.
descriptionZh: 金酒与干苦艾酒，冰镇搅拌，更冷上桌。文明人的饮品。

details.eyebrowZh: 经典 · 搅拌 · 酒精度约28%
ingrEn: 2.5 oz (75ml) London Dry Gin (or vodka for a Vodka Martini)
ingrZh: 2.5 oz (75ml) 伦敦干金酒（或伏特加做成伏特加马丁尼）
1滴 橙皮苦精（可选但推荐）
stepsEn: Chill your martini glass in the freezer for at least 15 minutes, or fill with ice water while you prepare.
Combine gin, vermouth, and bitters in a mixing glass filled with large ice.
Stir for 40–50 seconds — longer than you think. You want maximum dilution and chill.
Strain into the chilled glass.
For a lemon twist: express the oil over the surface, rub around the rim, drop in or balance on the rim. For an olive: skewer 1–3 on a pick and drop in.
stepsZh: 将马丁尼杯放入冰箱至少冰镇15分钟，或在准备时用冰水装满杯子。
将金酒、苦艾酒和苦精倒入装有大冰块的调酒杯。
搅拌40-50秒——比你以为的要长。要最大程度冷却和稀释。
过滤入冰镇好的杯中。
柠檬皮卷：在杯面上方扭取油脂，擦杯口，放入或搭在杯沿。橄榄：用签串1-3颗放入杯中。
details.notesEn: The Martini is a canvas for your preferences. Wetter (more vermouth) is not worse — it's more nuanced. I prefer a 5:1 ratio and always use vermouth that has been stored in the fridge (it oxidizes). Never shake unless you want a cloudy, bruised drink. The Bond instruction was wrong.
details.notesZh: 马丁尼是展现个人偏好的画布。更湿（更多苦艾酒）并非更差——而是更有层次。我偏好5:1的比例，并且始终使用冷藏保存的苦艾酒（它会氧化变质）。除非想要混浊的酒，否则永远不要摇制。邦德的吩咐是错误的。

descriptionEn: Equal parts gin, green Chartreuse, maraschino, lime. A forgotten classic, perfectly balanced.
descriptionZh: 金酒、绿色查特酒、黑樱桃利口酒、青柠各等份。被遗忘的经典，完美平衡。

details.eyebrowZh: 禁酒令时代 · 摇制 · 酒精度约24%
ingrZh: ¾ oz (22ml) 黑樱桃利口酒（推荐Luxardo）
stepsEn: Combine all four ingredients in equal measure in a shaker with ice.
Shake hard for 12 seconds.
Double-strain into a chilled coupe.
Garnish with a lime wheel or a single maraschino cherry.
stepsZh: 将四种材料等量放入加有冰块的摇壶。
用力摇12秒。
双重过滤至冰镇碟形杯。
用青柠片或一颗黑樱桃装饰。
details.notesEn: Invented at the Detroit Athletic Club around 1916, the Last Word disappeared during Prohibition and was largely forgotten until bartender Murray Stenson rediscovered it at Zig Zag Café in Seattle around 2004. The equal-parts format is the same elegant logic as the Paper Plane — every ingredient holds its ground. Green Chartreuse is the soul of the drink; there is no substitute. The combination of herbal, sweet, tart and spirit-forward is unlike anything else in the canon.
details.notesZh: 约于1916年发明于底特律运动俱乐部，禁酒令期间销声匿迹，直到2004年前后被西雅图Zig Zag Café的调酒师穆雷·斯滕森重新发现。等份配方与纸飞机一样优雅——每种材料都不退让。绿色查特酒是这杯酒的灵魂，无可替代。草本、甜润、酸爽与烈酒感的组合，是整个调酒经典中独一无二的存在。

descriptionEn: My signature farewell drink. Made for the last round of the night.
descriptionZh: 我的招牌告别之饮，为今晚最后一杯而生。

details.eyebrowZh: 原创 · 摇制 · 酒精度约18%
ingrEn: 1.5 oz (45ml) Aged rum (Ron Zacapa or similar)
¼ oz (7ml) Honey syrup (2:1 honey to water)
ingrZh: 1.5 oz (45ml) 陈年朗姆酒（推荐Ron Zacapa或同类）
stepsEn: Combine all ingredients in a shaker with ice.
Shake for 12 seconds.
Double-strain into a chilled coupe.
Express an orange peel over the surface — hold it above the glass and snap it firmly to release the oils. Run it around the rim, then rest it on the edge.
stepsZh: 将所有材料加入装有冰块的摇壶。
摇12秒。
双重过滤至冰镇碟形杯。
在杯面上方扭转橙皮取油——用力折压，让油脂喷洒在酒液表面。擦一圈杯口，搭在杯沿。
details.notesEn: This is the drink I make at the end of a long night behind the bar — for myself or for whoever is still there. The aged rum gives it warmth and depth, the Amaro Nonino adds a bittersweet complexity, and the honey softens everything without losing the edges. The name came naturally: it is the kind of drink that feels like a quiet goodbye. Not dramatic. Just — see you tomorrow.
details.notesZh: 这是我在吧台后漫长一夜结束时调的那杯酒——为自己，或者为还留在那里的人。陈年朗姆带来温度和深度，诺尼诺阿马罗增添苦甜的层次，蜂蜜将一切柔和而不失棱角。名字自然而然地来了：这杯酒有一种安静告别的感觉。不戏剧化。只是——明日再见。
